text: emma: quick bug found in compact dashboard: the tiny sparklines in the 3-column compact view (height ~22px) show per-point tooltips. when you scrub or tab through they all open and it floods the screen :sweat_smile: oliver: which browser/a11y combo? can't repro on my linux chrome emma: reproduced on mac chrome + VoiceOver and on Windows + NVDA. customer demo hit it earlier today, felt very noisy tara: are these the yellow anomaly flags? we added per-point timestamps last sprint emma: yep. every flag creates its own tooltip. keyboard users get stuck cycling through each one jonah: proposal: render visual flags but surface one single interactive control per-sparkline for assistive tech. on hover show a compact aggregated popup like: "3 spikes · last 2025-02-18 09:12 · Show timeline" michael: copy question: do we call them "spikes" or "anomalies" in product copy? folks keep using both in calls oliver: product prefers "anomalies" in formal docs but engineers and customers say "spikes". maybe use "spikes" in tiny UIs and "anomalies" in docs? tara: accessibility suggestion: make the control focusable and announce a single summary. e.g. aria-label="Sparkline: latest 420ms, 2 spikes, press Enter to open timeline". use aria-expanded / aria-controls for the expanded panel emma: subtle implementation note: we tried pointer-events: none on markers to prevent tooltip popups, but that broke focusability for NVDA when markers were links oliver: alternative: markers aria-hidden="true" + a visually-hidden list inside the aggregate control for screen readers. example: ``` ``` that way we keep visuals but one accessible target jonah: telemetry: change event name from tooltip_point_hover_compact -> tooltip_compact_aggregate to preserve tracking. we'll also emit aggregate_open and aggregate_keyboard_open michael: product copy: prefer "Show timeline" over "View details" here. shorter and clearer when the UI is small tara: tiny nit: unit label should be "P95 latency" rather than "95th" in the aggregate popup so non-technical users understand emma: design-bot: uploaded two variants: one where aggregate is inline, another where it expands into a popover with list of flagged points. both in figma: https://figma.redwood/proto/ux-1743219876 design-bot: sketch uploaded oliver: i'll mock the aria-hidden approach and post a short demo GIF. can QA run quick NVDA + VoiceOver check on the inline-aggregate? jonah: plan: oliver builds demo -> tara + emma test with screen readers -> finalize copy with michael -> ship behind prod-flag. effort estimate: 1 dev + 1 design day, QA half day emma: thanks. leaving a comment in the figma with the P95 copy and telemetry events :thumbsup:
